pages.text: [#](53341a)Your studies here are done. The next chapter — **Collecting Fumes** — opens once you craft and read its book.[#]()
pages.title: What Comes Next

pages.text: [#](53341a)The Witches' Oven is the first station a witch builds — and you build it before all else, because Herbology's Mutandis is compounded from the **Wood Ash** the Oven renders. Learn the smoke first, then the green.[#]()
